::: {#sol-vae-idea}

Let the encoder output a normal distribution for each image,
with a mean and a standard deviation for each coordinate of the code,
and train the decoder on draws from it.
Then add to the loss the [KL divergence](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-kl-divergence) of each of those distributions from $\dNf{0, 1}$.
The penalty pulls every image's distribution toward the standard normal,
so a draw from $\dNf{\vzero, \idmat}$ lands where the decoder has seen codes.
This needs two results:
the KL divergence between two normal distributions,
and a way to differentiate through a random draw.

:::
